resources.name: Open-source quantum chemistry package (e.g., PySCF, NWChem, ORCA)

access.notes: Must support B3LYP/6-311G(d,p) geometry optimization, frequency analysis, and electrostatic potential analysis.
Installable via pip from PyPI. Used for data processing, molecular structure generation, and ESP descriptor computation.

Benchmark experimental Δ_fH°(g) values for reference species (1,2,4-triazole, 1H-tetrazole, aniline, NO2, NH3, N3) are provided directly in the task instructions, extracted from NIST Chemistry WebBook.

resources.name: Molecular structure definitions for target compounds

access.notes: Structural descriptions (e.g., SMILES, connectivity) are provided in the task instructions. The agent must build initial geometries using a cheminformatics tool (e.g., RDKit).
